name: SentinelX
description: An enterprise-grade, asynchronous log pipeline engineered to ingest, normalize, and audit logs. Detect threats concurrently across 5 analytic engines backed by machine learning models and AI.
features: Processes logs up to 300 MB safely using custom file streams
Tiered log-type penalties for greedy fallbacks out of 13 supported types
Unsupervised Isolation Forest automatically flags outliers
Deterministic GeoIP routing and AI-driven recommendations

name: Expenzo
description: A comprehensive personal finance and budget tracking application with rich analytics.
features: Interactive dashboard visualizing monthly and yearly expenses with Chart.js
Budget limit monitoring and dynamic alert notifications
Secure user authentication with JWT and password encryption
Filtering, search, and categorization of transaction records

name: CampusMate
description: A collaborative platform designed to streamline student resource sharing and communication on campus.
features: Peer-to-peer textbook and study resource exchange marketplace
Real-time chat channels for projects, study groups, and campus events
Interactive events feed and exam schedule tracker

name: JobSync
description: An intuitive job search aggregator and application tracking system built for modern job seekers.
features: Centralized job search database aggregating listings from multiple platforms
Kanban tracking board to organize stages from Applied to Interviewing and Offers
Automated deadline notifications and notes logging for interview prep

name: PhishLense
description: A cybersecurity analytics platform and detector identifying phishing attempts and malicious URLs.
features: Machine learning models evaluating URL heuristics and metadata
Real-time warning system with detailed threat indicator scores
Historical logs and visual charts summarizing scanning statistics

name: Podcaster
description: An AI-powered podcast generation and streaming platform.
features: Text-to-speech AI podcast generation and custom audio generation
Secure user authentication and workspace organization
Real-time database updates and premium streaming interface

name: Promptly
description: An open-source AI prompting tool to discover, create, and share creative prompts.
features: Social sharing framework for prompts with searchable category tags
One-click copy-to-clipboard and responsive search controls
User profiles saving user-specific prompts and curated favorites
